WITH candidates AS (
SELECT CONCAT(#{code}, '') AS security_code
)
SELECT c.security_code , ps.target_pool_id AS pool_id FROM candidates c INNER JOIN ip_pool_status ps ON ps.security_code = c.security_code WHERE ps.audit_status = '20' AND ps.is_deleted = 0

WITH candidates AS (
SELECT CONCAT(#{code}, '') AS security_code
)
SELECT c.security_code FROM candidates c WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_adjust_log al INNER JOIN ip_adjust_step s ON s.adjust_batch_no = al.adjust_batch_no AND s.step_status = 'pending' WHERE al.security_code = c.security_code AND al.is_deleted = 0 )

SELECT DISTINCT ips.target_pool_id FROM ip_pool_status ips INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = ips.security_type AND dst.category_type = 'company' AND dst.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ip_investment_pool p ON p.id = ips.target_pool_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status = 'enabled' WHERE ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 AND p.pool_type != 'crmw' ORDER BY ips.target_pool_id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT pool_id FROM ip_pool_auto_rule WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND task_code = #{taskCode} AND rule_type = #{ruleType} AND pool_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pool_id ASC

SELECT ips.id AS pool_status_id , ips.security_code , ips.security_short_name , ips.security_type , si.delist_date , si.security_status
, restricted.security_code IS NOT NULL AS out_restricted
FROM ip_pool_status ips INNER JOIN rrs_securityinfo si ON si.wind_code = ips.security_code INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = ips.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 AND dst.category_type = 'bond'
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT security_code FROM ip_pool_status WHERE audit_status = '20' AND is_deleted = 0 AND target_pool_id IN
#{id}
) restricted ON restricted.security_code = ips.security_code
WHERE ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 AND (si.security_status = 'D' OR (si.delist_date IS NOT NULL AND si.delist_date < DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{maturityOffsetDays} DAY), '%Y%m%d')))

SELECT ips.security_code , MAX(ips.security_short_name) AS security_short_name , 'company' AS security_type FROM ip_pool_status ips WHERE ips.target_pool_id = #{sourcePoolId} AND ips.security_type = 'company' AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status tgt WHERE tgt.security_code = ips.security_code AND tgt.target_pool_id = #{targetPoolId} AND tgt.security_type = 'company' AND tgt.audit_status = '20' AND tgt.is_deleted = 0 ) GROUP BY ips.security_code ORDER BY ips.security_code ASC

WITH rated AS ( SELECT r.s_info_compcode , r.s_info_compname , r.b_info_creditrating , r.ann_dt , CASE REGEXP_SUBSTR(TRIM(r.b_info_creditrating), '^(A+|B+|C+|D)[+-]?', 1, 1, 'c') WHEN 'AAA+' THEN 21 WHEN 'AAA' THEN 20 WHEN 'AA+' THEN 19 WHEN 'AA' THEN 18 WHEN 'AA-' THEN 17 WHEN 'A+' THEN 16 WHEN 'A' THEN 15 WHEN 'A-' THEN 14 WHEN 'BBB+' THEN 13 WHEN 'BBB' THEN 12 WHEN 'BBB-' THEN 11 WHEN 'BB+' THEN 10 WHEN 'BB' THEN 9 WHEN 'BB-' THEN 8 WHEN 'B+' THEN 7 WHEN 'B' THEN 6 WHEN 'B-' THEN 5 WHEN 'CCC' THEN 4 WHEN 'CC' THEN 3 WHEN 'C' THEN 2 WHEN 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 999 END AS rating_value FROM ais_inv_ods.wind_cbondissuerrating r WHERE r.b_info_creditrating IS NOT NULL
AND r.b_info_creditratingagency IN
#{agencyCode}
AND 1 = 0
AND r.ann_dt >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), '%Y%m%d') )
, effective AS ( SELECT s_info_compcode , s_info_compname , b_info_creditrating , rating_value FROM ( SELECT s_info_compcode , s_info_compname , b_info_creditrating , rating_value , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY s_info_compcode ORDER BY rating_value ASC , ann_dt DESC ) AS rn FROM rated ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 )
SELECT e.s_info_compcode AS security_code , COALESCE(NULLIF(e.s_info_compname, ''), e.s_info_compcode) AS security_short_name , 'company' AS security_type , e.b_info_creditrating AS outer_rating FROM effective e WHERE e.rating_value <= 17 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status ips WHERE ips.security_code = e.s_info_compcode AND ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.security_type = 'company' AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY e.s_info_compcode ASC

WITH rated AS ( SELECT r.s_info_compcode , r.s_info_compname , r.b_info_creditrating , r.ann_dt , CASE REGEXP_SUBSTR(TRIM(r.b_info_creditrating), '^(A+|B+|C+|D)[+-]?', 1, 1, 'c') WHEN 'AAA+' THEN 21 WHEN 'AAA' THEN 20 WHEN 'AA+' THEN 19 WHEN 'AA' THEN 18 WHEN 'AA-' THEN 17 WHEN 'A+' THEN 16 WHEN 'A' THEN 15 WHEN 'A-' THEN 14 WHEN 'BBB+' THEN 13 WHEN 'BBB' THEN 12 WHEN 'BBB-' THEN 11 WHEN 'BB+' THEN 10 WHEN 'BB' THEN 9 WHEN 'BB-' THEN 8 WHEN 'B+' THEN 7 WHEN 'B' THEN 6 WHEN 'B-' THEN 5 WHEN 'CCC' THEN 4 WHEN 'CC' THEN 3 WHEN 'C' THEN 2 WHEN 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 999 END AS rating_value FROM ais_inv_ods.wind_cbondissuerrating r WHERE r.b_info_creditrating IS NOT NULL
AND r.b_info_creditratingagency IN
#{agencyCode}
AND 1 = 0
AND r.ann_dt >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), '%Y%m%d') )
, effective AS ( SELECT s_info_compcode , s_info_compname , b_info_creditrating , rating_value FROM ( SELECT s_info_compcode , s_info_compname , b_info_creditrating , rating_value , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY s_info_compcode ORDER BY rating_value ASC , ann_dt DESC ) AS rn FROM rated ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 )
SELECT ips.id AS pool_status_id , ips.security_code , COALESCE(NULLIF(e.s_info_compname, ''), NULLIF(ips.security_short_name, ''), ips.security_code) AS security_short_name , 'company' AS security_type , e.b_info_creditrating AS outer_rating FROM ip_pool_status ips LEFT JOIN effective e ON e.s_info_compcode = ips.security_code WHERE ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.security_type = 'company' AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 AND e.rating_value > 17
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status lim WHERE lim.security_code = ips.security_code AND lim.security_type = 'company' AND lim.audit_status = '20' AND lim.is_deleted = 0 AND lim.target_pool_id IN
#{limitPoolId}
)
ORDER BY ips.security_code ASC
SELECT DISTINCT ips.security_code FROM ip_pool_status ips WHERE ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.security_type = 'company' AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0

SELECT ips.id AS pool_status_id , ips.security_code , ips.security_short_name , ips.security_type , ips.crmw_name , ips.crmw_scode , ips.crmw_mktcode , ips.crmw_stype , crmw.delist_date , crmw.security_status
, restricted.security_code IS NOT NULL AS out_restricted
FROM ip_pool_status_crmw ips INNER JOIN rrs_securityinfo crmw ON crmw.wind_code = ips.crmw_scode
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT security_code , crmw_scode , crmw_stype FROM ip_pool_status_crmw WHERE pool_type = 'crmw' AND audit_status = '20' AND is_deleted = 0 AND target_pool_id IN
#{id}
) restricted ON restricted.security_code = ips.security_code AND restricted.crmw_scode = ips.crmw_scode AND restricted.crmw_stype = ips.crmw_stype
WHERE ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 AND ips.pool_type = 'crmw' AND crmw.security_type = 'crmw' AND (crmw.security_status = 'D' OR (crmw.delist_date IS NOT NULL AND crmw.delist_date < DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{maturityOffsetDays} DAY), '%Y%m%d'))) ORDER BY ips.crmw_scode ASC , ips.security_code ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ip_pool_status_crmw SET is_deleted = 1 , updt_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{poolStatusId} AND audit_status = '20' AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ps.target_pool_id FROM ip_pool_status ps WHERE ps.security_type = 'company' AND ps.audit_status = '20' AND ps.target_pool_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT bond.wind_code AS security_code , bond.short_name AS security_short_name , bond.security_type , bond.abs_flag , bond.issuer_code , bond.issuer AS issuer_name , bond.issuer_code AS trigger_company_code , bond.delist_date FROM rrs_securityinfo bond INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = bond.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 AND dst.category_type = 'bond' WHERE bond.security_status != 'D'
AND NOT (COALESCE(bond.abs_flag, 0) = 1 OR bond.security_type = 'abs')
AND bond.security_type NOT IN
#{securityType}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status cps INNER JOIN dict_security_type cdst ON cdst.security_type = cps.security_type AND cdst.is_deleted = 0 AND cdst.category_type = 'company' WHERE cps.security_code = bond.issuer_code AND cps.target_pool_id = #{companyPoolId} AND cps.audit_status = '20' AND cps.is_deleted = 0 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status bps WHERE bps.security_code = bond.wind_code AND bps.target_pool_id = #{targetPoolId} AND bps.audit_status = '20' AND bps.is_deleted = 0 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rrs_temp_security_code ts WHERE ts.temp_security_code = bond.wind_code AND ts.security_code IS NOT NULL AND IFNULL(ts.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND ts.status = 'updated' ) ORDER BY bond.wind_code ASC

SELECT ps.id AS pool_status_id , bond.wind_code AS security_code , bond.short_name AS security_short_name , bond.security_type , bond.issuer_code , bond.issuer AS issuer_name , CASE WHEN bond.security_status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS inactive_for_ordinary_out FROM ip_pool_status ps INNER JOIN rrs_securityinfo bond ON bond.wind_code = ps.security_code INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = bond.security_type AND dst.category_type = 'bond' AND dst.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ps.target_pool_id = #{bondPoolId} AND ps.audit_status = '20' AND ps.is_deleted = 0 AND ps.adjust_mode = '调入' AND NOT (COALESCE(bond.abs_flag, 0) = 1 OR bond.security_type = 'abs') AND bond.issuer_code IS NOT NULL AND ((ps.adjust_type = '自动调整' AND (ps.adjust_reason LIKE '【任务名称：%】【主体跟随】（%' OR (ps.adjust_batch_no LIKE 'BOND%' AND (ps.adjust_reason LIKE '【任务名称：主体下债券自动入池（已排除ABS债）】（%主体所在池：%' OR ps.adjust_reason LIKE '【任务名称：在池主体旗下债券自动入池（已排除ABS债）】（%主体所在池：%')))) OR ps.adjust_type IN ('自动调整', '联动调整') AND ps.adjust_batch_no LIKE 'COMP%' AND (ps.adjust_reason LIKE '主体“%”调入，旗下债券自动同步调整%' OR ps.adjust_reason LIKE '【任务名称：%】%（同池旗下债）')) ORDER BY bond.wind_code , ps.id

SELECT security_code , target_pool_id AS pool_id FROM ip_pool_status WHERE security_type = 'company' AND security_code IS NOT NULL AND audit_status = '20' AND is_deleted = 0 AND target_pool_id IN
#{poolId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ip_pool_status SET is_deleted = 1 , updt_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{poolStatusId} AND audit_status = '20' AND is_deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_adjust_log src WHERE src.adjust_batch_no = ip_pool_status.adjust_batch_no AND src.adjust_type = 'Excel导入' AND src.adjust_mode = '调入' AND src.audit_status = '20' AND src.is_deleted = 0 )
